references.text: God promises to bless Ishmael and make him very fruitful, with twelve princes as descendants – a direct fulfillment of the promise given to Hagar.
God repeats the promise to Hagar that Ishmael will become a great nation, in line with the angel's words in Gen 16:10.
God promises Abraham that his descendants will be as numerous as the stars and the sand, a parallel promise of countless offspring.
Ishmael's twelve sons and tribal princes are listed – the concrete fulfillment of the promise to Hagar about countless offspring.
Paul uses Hagar and Sarah as allegories for two covenants. Hagar represents the covenant of Sinai and slavery, while Sarah represents the covenant of promise.
Direct recall of God's promise of endless descendants from Hagar to Jacob.
Direct quote/allusion confirming that the promise of endless descendants is an eternal oath by God.
Prophetic renewal of the promise of countless offspring, extended to include those who were previously rejected.
